summary.name: TypeWhisper
summary.one_liner: TypeWhisper is a free, open-source speech-to-text app for macOS, Windows, and iOS that dictates into any app using local or chosen cloud engines.
use_cases: Draft legal or architecture notes by voice
Clean up dictation with AI workflows
summary.what_it_does: TypeWhisper captures speech via a hotkey and types the result into the active text field in any app, with rules per app or website. Local engines (WhisperKit, Parakeet, Apple SpeechAnalyzer on macOS 26+, and Whisper on Windows) process audio on-device, while cloud ASR and LLM providers are used only if the user configures them. Workflows can remove filler words, fix punctuation, format meeting notes, and translate text. The app also transcribes audio and video files, keeps a searchable history, and offers local APIs, a CLI, and an SDK. Functionality is extended through 56 add-ons.
notable: Open source under GPLv3 with local engines and no telemetry
Workflows clean up dictation with filler removal, punctuation, and formatting
56 add-ons for engines, AI providers, Obsidian, and MCP tools, plus SDK and CLI
caveats: Premium sync, learning from corrections, and non-GPL terms require a paid commercial license (from EUR 5/month or one-time supporter contributions)
Apple SpeechAnalyzer engine requires macOS 26 or later
Language coverage depends on engine: Parakeet covers 25 European languages
Cloud engines and AI providers require the user's own configuration and API keys
